verdict.rationale: Starting a filing flow without an account is a fair question for a government tax portal, so the axis applies. The published pages only show 'Registar-se ... Iniciar Sessão' as the entry point, which suggests registration and login are required. Nothing documents a keyless or file-number-only path into the core tax or customs services, and public informational pages (help, parcel clearance info) are not the core online flow.
